mentions.claim_text: He and his son search through old recordings and he says they saw a major draft, praising the archive work.
mentions.quote: we saw a major draft
mentions.falsify_match: American conscription is reintroduced.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something bound in a pit and an angelic being from the Lord, not a demonic one, coming down and releasing the demonic spirit, which came up out of the pit and spun like a cartoon character.
mentions.quote: an angelic being come down and release that demonic spirit
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim concerns a released spirit.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says Poland was provoking Russia over the war and helping Ukraine but that there was more to it, and that around Warsaw near the Belarus area he saw something enormous.
mentions.quote: Poland was provoking Russia
mentions.falsify_match: A major strike near Warsaw following Polish provocation.

mentions.claim_text: He says they saw Warsaw in prayer and a provoking of the American military into it, asks how many years ago that was, and says they are now seeing things.
mentions.quote: I saw a provoking of our military to get in this
mentions.falsify_match: American forces drawn into a Polish conflict.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. The age of the vision is asserted rather than dated from the recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says he did not see the current president in that earlier vision because it was the previous one, thought the previous one would do something, and that three years later the current president is saying he is pulling troops out of NATO because they did not help with the strait.
mentions.quote: I'm pulling troops out of NATO. You didn't help me out with the strait
mentions.falsify_match: An American NATO withdrawal over the strait.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He says plainly the earlier vision had the wrong president in it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw sniffers going all over Cuba trying to detect it but that what they were looking for was encased in lead, and that he does not understand what he is seeing.
mentions.quote: I don't understand what I'm seeing
mentions.falsify_match: A shielded device is found in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He states his own incomprehension of the image.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a new mysterious plague on a boat with three dead and a suspected outbreak, and works out with his co-host whether it is hantavirus.
mentions.quote: a new mysterious plague on a boat. The three dead
mentions.falsify_match: A rodent borne outbreak spreads from that vessel.

mentions.claim_text: He is told it was mouse transmitted and that people sent it to him, says it is not it though, then agrees it would be like the black plague.
mentions.quote: it's not it though
mentions.falsify_match: The outbreak becomes the plague he described.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He says outright that this is not the thing he saw, which is a refusal to bank it.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not time for the church to have its head in the sand but to have a backbone like a crowbar, learn who they are and walk in authority, because they are not hearing this on mainstream media.
mentions.quote: It's time for the church to have a backbone like a crowbar
mentions.falsify_match: A visible change in the church's public posture.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls what he said about the strait, the president and Israel, that a lot of it will be blamed on Israel, and that he saw fuel queues like the 1970s which are now being compared.
mentions.quote: I saw gas lines like the 1970s
mentions.falsify_match: Fuel queues at 1970s scale in America.

mentions.claim_text: He sings the potter and clay hymn and says the Lord told him that as when he delivered the children out of Egypt, there was no feeble one among them.
mentions.quote: there was no feeble one among them
mentions.falsify_match: A movement marked by healings on that scale.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking partly in tongues he names the office of the president, a named Minnesota candidate and a named Florida candidate, and prays over Oklahoma and Texas.
mentions.quote: IT'S CONCERNING LINDELL, I SEE him now
mentions.falsify_match: Both named candidates win.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is tiptoeing around it but that with what is coming you had better be all in or on the other side, and that there is no time to play political theatre.
mentions.quote: you better be all in or you better be on the other side
mentions.falsify_match: A forced polarisation of religious commitment.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be a major revival, that God will visit the youth of America and the world with a shaking in the youth like they have never seen, and that in the days ahead he could use a named widow, with a new husband coming up beside her.
mentions.quote: I saw a new husband coming up beside her
mentions.falsify_match: A youth movement and a remarriage for the named person.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs. Naming a living widow's future remarriage is unusually specific and personal.

mentions.claim_text: He says he loves the audience anyway and prays for them but will tell them what he feels in his spirit truthfully, then turns to two hundred dollar oil with a not financial advice disclaimer.
mentions.quote: I will tell you what I feel in my spirit and be truthful
mentions.falsify_match: Oil above two hundred dollars.

mentions.claim_text: He says a two hundred dollar barrel would cause a massive depression, attributing the point to his son and another source, and notes the national debt surpassing the size of the economy.
mentions.quote: a $200 barrel oil would cause a massive depression
mentions.falsify_match: Two hundred dollar oil followed by a depression.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs. The economics here is sourced to others rather than to a word.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing no money coming out of the cash machines, and a fifty dollar bill on a hundred dollar bill on a flag waving with half of it faded out, from one of his first visions on the channel.
mentions.quote: I saw the $50 bill on a $100 bill on a flag
mentions.falsify_match: A cash access crisis and a currency devaluation.

mentions.claim_text: He says at that time nobody had any cash and the banks went bankrupt, that this is what he saw in a vision and remembers it clearly, then turns to a new retirement account and stimulus.
mentions.quote: there was nobody with any cash. And the banks went bankrupt
mentions.falsify_match: American bank failures with cash unavailable.

mentions.claim_text: He asks for healings and manifestations of the glory, then lifts up the war and says they will pray over Ukraine and Russia because that is what he just saw.
mentions.quote: We're going to pray over Ukraine and Russia
mentions.falsify_match: A change in the war following the prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will be watching South Korea in the days ahead and watching Japan, and watching what is coming across the land.
mentions.quote: You're going to be watching South Korea in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A major event involving South Korea and Japan.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Watch with no content attached cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was told he had to fix something because he could not get to the other side of it in the spirit, asked what was blocking him, was told it was his attitude toward his wife, apologised, and is being public about it.
mentions.quote: your attitude towards your wife
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a personal correction he reports against himself.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss, though volunteering it publicly is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He sees darkness over the east and New York with the train stations and the subways, and asks repeatedly when it is, saying too early and too late and that it does not have the impact.
mentions.quote: I see the train stations. I see. But when? When, Lord?
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on New York transport.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He is reasoning about what time of day would have the most impact, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says he still sees a provoking in Europe trying to draw the empire, an attempt to use the weapon never used before on Warsaw, a provoking from the French president, and an effort to draw America into a greater world war.
mentions.quote: a provoking trying to use that weapon that has never been used before on Warsaw
mentions.falsify_match: A novel weapon used near Warsaw drawing America in.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks at length in tongues without interpretation.
mentions.quote: Bon da ne ming ga ra
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an untranslated passage.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no content given.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a grey dove dead on the ground in Europe with ants eating its eyes, and says it was a beautiful bird at one time.
mentions.quote: I see this dove dead on the ground and it's in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: The dove resolves to an identifiable European figure or institution.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking partly in tongues he names two black crows with the cardinal and says this is so serious.
mentions.quote: There's two black crows. With that cardinal. It's the cardinal
mentions.falsify_match: The animals resolve to identifiable figures.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a very evil looking panda wrapped in its flag talking to the dragon and to North Korea, gazing at Taiwan which is glowing with yellow lights.
mentions.quote: It's very very evil-looking panda. It's wrapped in their flag
mentions.falsify_match: A China and North Korea move on Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he is looking at in Europe is a provoking allowed in order to cause a world war and a greater escalation, provoking the Russian president in exchange for help with Iran.
mentions.quote: An exchange for help with Iran
mentions.falsify_match: A European provocation traded for Russian cooperation on Iran.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jews in New York and around Europe uprooted and went home to Israel, and warns the audience that what he is about to say will annoy some of them but he does not care.
mentions.quote: they uprooted and they went back home. They went back to Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable wave of Jewish emigration to Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He checks the running time with his son, notes he kept it under thirty minutes at twenty eight, and says he is trying not to take all their time.
mentions.quote: I kept under 30. I saw it was after. Yeah, it was 28
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a production note.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord talked about the five families and is bringing them up, that there will be an uprising because he saw them, that it was business but they wanted to keep the main thing the main thing because of the Venezuelan leader.
mentions.quote: It was business, but they wanted to keep the main thing the main thing
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime involvement in the Venezuela matter.

mentions.claim_text: He says the five families will look like heroes with strong mafia ties coming against a change in New York, because of demonic and carnal evil thinking that is going to come out of it.
mentions.quote: I saw them acting looking like a hero, the five families
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime publicly cast as opposing the city administration.

mentions.claim_text: He says he gets weird names and does not know what they are because he is a country boy, that he told his wife this was a name he kept hearing, and that the Lord told her to write it down.
mentions.quote: This is a name I keep hearing
mentions.falsify_match: The named place becomes significant.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He states that he does not know what it is.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not get it but does what he is told and prayed over the named place for a long time, and that praying over Ukraine he saw a major world war across Europe with weapons they have not seen before.
mentions.quote: I don't get it, but I still do what he says
mentions.falsify_match: A European war involving the named place.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jesus is coming, they must repent and turn from their wicked ways because they are running out of time, that the signs are all around, and to watch what happens in Iran in the days ahead, which could even happen that night.
mentions.quote: Could even happen tonight. I wouldn't
mentions.falsify_match: A major Iranian event that night or shortly after.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Could even happen tonight with no content attached cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He warns that pride can set in and produce anger and bitterness, and says the man is only successful like David's mighty men because the hand of the Lord was on him rather than because he thinks he is good.
mentions.quote: You're only successful like David's mighty men of war because the hand
mentions.falsify_match: A fall attributed to pride.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord cares only about revival, wants revival in Venezuela and those areas, and will use whoever he wants just as he used David, who was a man of war.
mentions.quote: the Lord says, I want revival. That's all he cares about
mentions.falsify_match: A Venezuelan religious movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says the whole country will one day join up with America on the dollar rather than on borders, that Canada's economy is in trouble and that Mexico under a new leader he describes by nickname will join up too.
mentions.quote: The whole country at one in the future joins up with America. Dollar wise
mentions.falsify_match: A North American currency union.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the nation will be one nation again under God despite the division and strife, and quotes God bless America.
mentions.quote: our nation will be a nation, one nation under God
mentions.falsify_match: A reduction in national polarisation.

mentions.claim_text: He says prayer will bring it out of the media and expose it, that four named networks will try to bury it, and that this is the political theatre upon the land with an exposing of the darkness.
mentions.quote: ABC, NBC, CBS, CNN will try to bury it
mentions.falsify_match: A story the networks suppress emerges anyway.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. He does not say what the story is.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a major revival over Iran and for the removal of the supreme leader and the dictator, says the man is evil, and says the same of Cuba and Mexico.
mentions.quote: To remove the Ayatollah. To remove the dictator
mentions.falsify_match: Leadership change in all three.

mentions.claim_text: He says let it be a vote and be strategic, do not strong-arm it, and be cautious concerning the European Union no matter how right it looks for the picking.
mentions.quote: Don't be strong-arming this
mentions.falsify_match: An American move on Europe that goes badly.

mentions.claim_text: He says a leader not swayed by cartel money, then liberation coming to the Cubans which he feels released to pray for, but that at Greenland he feels caution and that something is not right.
mentions.quote: But I get to Greenland, I feel caution. Don't do that
mentions.falsify_match: A Greenland move that goes badly.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He distinguishes what he feels released to pray from what he does not, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He works out the word he wants, settling on diplomatic rather than dictator like, says not to be the bully in the schoolyard, to walk light and pray for the hearts, and to walk light with Europe.
mentions.quote: Don't be the bully in the school yard
mentions.falsify_match: A conciliatory American approach to Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is going to take Russia off but they are too weak to defend it because they are depleted from Ukraine, and that the leader has a big voice but it is a demonic spirit speaking through it.
mentions.quote: they're too weak to defend it. They're depleted from Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: Russia fails to respond to a challenge because of Ukraine attrition.

mentions.claim_text: He says they should pray for the valley of decision for the president, that this is just what he feels when he weighs it out in his spirit, and that people may say he is wrong.
mentions.quote: You say, Well, Brandon, you're wrong. Hey, it's just what I feel
mentions.falsify_match: A decisive presidential choice follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. He labels this as feeling rather than as a word, which is a distinction he does not always make.

mentions.claim_text: He says they want revival in Europe and South Korea, and that the Chinese leader is trying to bring an accord into South Korea to lure and trap them, adding that it is not really him because they wrestle not against flesh.
mentions.quote: Ping is trying to bring an accord into South Korea to lure them in
mentions.falsify_match: A China and South Korea agreement that turns against Seoul.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks the audience for coming and praying for the country and for Iran and the valley of decision, and gives the number watching as eleven thousand.
mentions.quote: We thank you for all 11,000 of you that came out
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an audience count.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He declares certain cryptocurrencies to flourish uninterrupted and unhindered by any satanic force, calls them to go to five dollars now, and says the bank arrangements will be signed and deals made.
mentions.quote: GO TO $5 NOW IN JESUS NAME. WE CALL IT IN
mentions.falsify_match: A named cryptocurrency reaches five dollars.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. He does not name which one, which removes the checkable part.

mentions.claim_text: He says he felt the unction of the Holy Spirit, that he was caught up in the spirit in prayer the day before, and asks them to hear carefully about the next two weeks.
mentions.quote: Over the next two weeks, I want you to hear this very carefully
mentions.falsify_match: The named events occur inside two weeks.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. A two week window is unusually tight for this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees in part, that he saw Pakistan and Iran highlighted, and that as a major thing was about to happen in Iran he heard antisemitism would be at an all time high in the days ahead, seeing New York City.
mentions.quote: I heard anti-semitism will be at an all-time high in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Recorded antisemitic incidents reach a documented high after an Iranian event.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw people fleeing to Israel, uprooting their families from major cities saying they had had enough, and moving there.
mentions.quote: They were uprooting their families and they said, We've had enough
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of emigration to Israel from American cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says he found it interesting, that God said he was bringing his people home and bringing the Jewish people home, and that he saw Jews going to Israel in mass numbers.
mentions.quote: He was bringing the Jewish people home
mentions.falsify_match: Mass aliyah from Western countries.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the 41st floor of a major New York building on fire again, a lot of fires in buildings and rioting coming to New York in the days ahead, and that the Lord keeps showing him this.
mentions.quote: I saw again the 41st floor of a major building on fire
mentions.falsify_match: A fire involving the 41st floor of a New York building.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. This is six months earlier than the telling the claim was seeded from.

mentions.claim_text: He says on the Friday he saw young men paid off by the drug cartel in Venezuela trying to raise an army against American troops on the ground there, oriented toward Brazil, and Cuba devising a plan to create civil unrest.
mentions.quote: young men being paid off by the drug cartel in Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: An irregular force raised against American troops in Venezuela.
